cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Bring Back Everything
cards.instruction: Return early details in altered forms until the scene feels like it has been building toward one unavoidable consequence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put the cake on that spare chair. I'll keep the table clear until everyone has sat down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That leaves one guest without a seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give them the piano stool. The pianist can stand for the birthday song; I'll tell him when to start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He needs both hands to play, and the guest has put the cake on his lap so he can use the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the pianist can have his stool back. Bring the chair to the table and put the cake on it; I'll cut it now. We've seated everyone except the thing I was saving for later.

reason: Keep explicit furniture roles and cake placement; B guest solution returns stool but makes early serving the authoritative outcome, without mysterious pianist-at-window geometry.
